---
title: "Codes for Plots and Tables"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| warning: true

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(haven)

demo <- read_xpt("https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2021/DataFiles/DEMO_L.xpt")

BIOPRO_L <- read_xpt("https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2021/DataFiles/BIOPRO_L.xpt")

bmx <- read_xpt("https://wwwn.cdc.gov/Nchs/Data/Nhanes/Public/2021/DataFiles/BMX_L.xpt")

```

```{r}
#| label: merge-adult-data
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| warning: true

nhanes_adults <- demo |>
  left_join(BIOPRO_L, by = "SEQN") |>
  left_join(bmx, by = "SEQN") |>
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 18)



```

```{r}
#| label: adult-sample-check


nrow(nhanes_adults)

summary(nhanes_adults$RIDAGEYR)
```

```{r}
#| label: adult-creatinine-summary

nhanes_adults |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(LBXSCR)),
    mean = mean(LBXSCR, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(LBXSCR, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(LBXSCR, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(LBXSCR, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(LBXSCR, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(LBXSCR, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(LBXSCR, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: adult-creatinine-histogram

ggplot(nhanes_adults, aes(x = LBXSCR)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "white"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Serum Creatinine Among Adults",
    x = "Serum Creatinine (mg/dL)",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: age-creatinine-plot

ggplot(nhanes_adults, aes(x = RIDAGEYR, y = LBXSCR)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Age vs. Serum Creatinine",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Serum Creatinine (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: sex-creatinine-plot

ggplot(nhanes_adults,
       aes(x = factor(RIAGENDR), y = LBXSCR)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Serum Creatinine by Sex",
    x = "Sex (1 = Male, 2 = Female)",
    y = "Serum Creatinine (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| label: bmi-creatinine-plot

ggplot(nhanes_adults, aes(x = BMXBMI, y = LBXSCR)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "BMI vs. Serum Creatinine",
    x = "Body Mass Index (kg/m²)",
    y = "Serum Creatinine (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
